data.name: Atharv
data.gender_notes: Atharv is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit atharvan, the name of a Vedic sage and of the fourth Veda. Its root is Sanskrit atharvan (अथर्वन्). The Atharva Veda, the fourth Veda. Atharv is a Sanskrit name meaning “The Atharva Veda; a sage”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Atharv expresses “The Atharva Veda; a sage”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit atharvan, the name of a Vedic sage and of the fourth Veda.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atharv total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
